questions.question: Of the following male organs, which one is considered a primary sex organ?
The ________ are the site of sperm maturation, and they store and convey spermatozoa to the dectus deferentia
The ________ of the testes secrete male hormones, such as testosterone.
Which of these is not an action of the male androgens?
options: deposition of subcutaneous fat on the hips and thighs
growth of facial and axillary hair

questions.question: Choose the correct order for the path of sperm from the testes to outside the body.
options: ductus deferens - epididymis - ejaculatory duct - penis
epididymis - ductus deferens - ejaculatory duct - penis
ejaculatory duct - ductus deferens - epididymis - penis
penis - ejaculatory duct - epididymis - ductus deferens

questions.question: What does the prostate gland secrete into the semen?
options: alkaline secretion to aid the survival of sperm in the acidic atmosphere of the female reproductive tract
thin liquid that helps sperm become motile
All of these are secretions of the prostate.

questions.question: What portions of the penis contain erectile tissue that becomes engorged with blood?
During sexual arousal, ________ impulses cause vasodilation of the arterioles of the penis
options: None of these - vasodilation is the result of hormonal influences.
